answers.how: The post rises about 256 px/s, giving 0.2/256 m per pixel. The phone's image diagonal is about 252 px.
The upper gray truncated cone is about 141 px across. Using the motion-derived scale, its diameter is 141 × 0.2/256 m.
At 0.5 s, the post has risen approximately 117 px from its initial position. Applying the motion-derived scale gives about 0.0917 m of extension.
